title: Records a Continuous Quality Improvement Program must keep
rule_summary: Each pharmacy shall maintain a written copy of its CQI Program description on the pharmacy premises, and the description shall be readily available to all pharmacy personnel. Each pharmacy shall maintain a record of all QREs for a minimum period of two years from the date of the QRE report. QRE records shall be maintained in an orderly manner and filed by date. QRE records may be stored at a site other than the pharmacy where the QRE occurred.
exam_relevance: Tests the two-year QRE retention period, its start point at the date of the QRE report, and the filing and storage conditions that accompany it.

numeric_facts.fact: retention of the record of a Quality Related Event
numeric_facts.conditions: minimum period, from the date of the QRE report

common_confusions: The two-year QRE period runs from the date of the QRE report, while the five-year serious-event period in 247 CMR 20.02(4) runs from the date the report is filed with the Board.
QRE records may be stored off the premises where the event occurred, but the written CQI Program description must be on the pharmacy premises.
verification_notes: Read in the official 247 CMR 15.04 text published at mass.gov on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed. A fresh independent audit is still required before any section relying on it is published.
